<davidecrapis> re: **@davidecrapis**
> https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1577
PSA: we moved the breakout to the following week — July 2 at the same time, as updated in the issue.

@adietrichs and I will introduce a few areas of focus for the glamsterdam fork, and then we'll have discussions on drafts & proposals for each of them.

Please comment with anything relevant, we will finalize the schedule by end of next week.
